fix: The bearer_container is 'vascular bundle' (PO_0005020). For 'veins N on each side of midrib' the container should be the leaf lamina (PO_0020039), not the vein class.
reason: The flora gives 3-5 lateral veins on each side of the midrib. The bearer, the count and the each-side position with the midrib landmark (PO_0020139) all match.

'Petiole ... epidermis not flaking off': exfoliating, negated, said of the petiole's surface. FLOPO_0991021 is defined for a surface tissue or for the axis that bears it, so the petiole is an acceptable bearer.

fix: Same container problem as A06750: the container should be the leaf lamina, not 'vascular bundle'.
reason: 'Lateral nerves 3–5 on each side' gives 3-5 secondary veins on each side.

fix: Pattern 'X porteurs d'un Y pouvant atteindre N cm' (X bearing a Y up to N cm): the measurement belongs to Y, the last noun, not to X. Also 'pouvant atteindre' means 'up to', so the value is a maximum.
reason: The 2–3 cm length is that of the tuber borne on the stolons. The stolons themselves are described only as long and slender.
Annual herb up to 7.5 dm tall, which is up to 75 cm plant height.
In a leaf-blade description, 'glabrous below' means the abaxial surface. Swapping in the abaxial epidermis of the lamina is right.

fix: In a list under 'Seeds:' (aril whitish, testa black), each named sub-part is the bearer, not the heading organ.
reason: The whitish colour is said of the aril, not of the whole seed.
In FNA, plant size 'H × W dm' is height × width. Height 1-20 dm becomes 10-200 cm, with the 0.5 dm extreme kept as 5 cm.
'Twigs: ... older gray': older twigs (stem with the context 'old', PATO_0000308) are gray. A twig-specific bearer would be better but is not needed.

fix: In FNA, a single size given for an involucre is its height. Diameter is written as 'diam.' or as the second number in 'H × D'.
reason: 'Involucres ... 2–5 cm in fruit' gives involucre height, not diameter. The fruiting-stage context is right.

fix: Container should be the leaf lamina, not 'vascular bundle' (as in A06750).
reason: 3–6 lateral veins on each side.

target: head-shaped/knob-like shape (no exact term; nearest is spherical PATO_0001499)
fix: 'Capitate' said of a stigma, gland or trichome tip means head-shaped (a shape). FLOPO_0991006 is the aggregation of flowers into heads and is defined only for inflorescences and flowers. Restrict FLOPO_0991006 to those bearers.
reason: A subcapitate stigma is roughly knob-shaped. It is not flowers clustered into a head.

fix: The (0.5-) extreme is dropped here but kept in A06757 (value_min_extreme). Carry the lower extreme for this pattern too.
reason: Plant size H × W: height 1-5 dm becomes 10-50 cm. The main range is right; only the rare extreme of 5 cm is missing.
Under 'Male flowers', bracteoles are ca. 1 mm. The male-flower whole context is right.

target: higher order inflorescence axis (PO_0009081) as bearer, inflorescence (PO_0009049) as container
fix: For 'Panicle ...; branches N per node', the counted part is the inflorescence branch and the panicle is its container. Here bearer and container are swapped. The landmark should be an inflorescence node, not a stem node.
reason: What is counted (2–6 per node) is the panicle branches, not the inflorescence.
Racemes subsecund means roughly secund, with the 'approximately' qualifier.
The umbel's bracteoles are absent; the negated presence is right.

fix: 'N, rarely up to M' means the usual value N and a rare maximum M (up to M). It does not mean exactly M. Encode a range or a max-extreme, not M–M.
reason: The annotation states that leaflets are exactly 7 (rarely). The flora says usually 3 and rarely as many as 7.
Bracts ovate-lanceolate: the shape continuum from ovate to lanceolate is right.

fix: 'Germination epigeal/hypogeal' describes where the cotyledons are during germination (raised above ground or staying below). The rule should put the quality on the cotyledons with a germination-stage context, not on the seed.
reason: Epigeal germination means the cotyledons are raised above the soil. It does not say the seed is aerial.
'Loge ovarienne 8-12 ovulée' means 8-12 ovules per ovary locule (container PO_0025266).

fix: The whole 'Fleurs centrales hermaphrodites' (disc flowers) is not carried. Adding it would be better.
reason: The corolla of the central flowers is glabrous. Without the disc-flower context the statement is less precise but not shown false.
'The latter' refers to the lateral nerves: 8 or 9 on each side.

target: leaf lamina with a 'synflorescence leaf' context (leaves within the inflorescence)
fix: In 'synflorescence leaves ...' or 'upper/cauline leaves ...', the qualifier names a subset of leaves and must be carried as context.
reason: The 0.3-2.2 cm width is for the synflorescence leaves only. The other leaves are much wider (3.2-11 cm), so without the context the statement is false.
Calyx lobes 6-18 × 2-6 mm gives a width of 2-6 mm. Sepal is an acceptable bearer for calyx lobes.

fix: 'Juvenile leaves X; adult Y' contrasts leaf stages. 'Juvenile' must become the bearer (PO_0006339) or a stage context.
reason: Only the juvenile leaves are ovate or round. The adult leaves are lanceolate, so 'leaf ovate or round' is false without the stage.

target: stem with the position 'basal internodes' on the pilose alternative
fix: 'Glabrous or [part] pilose': the second alternative applies to a named sub-part. That part must be carried as a position or bearer for that value only.
reason: The stems are glabrous, or only the basal internodes are sparingly pilose. The flora does not say the whole stem is pilose.
Tree or shrub: tree habit or shrub habit as alternatives.
The terminal pinna (leaflet with the context 'terminal') is broadly obovate.
Leaves 0.25–1(–1.8) mm wide: the range and its maximum extreme are right.
